name: SiteBirds | AI Chat, Lead Capture, Bookings & Accessibility
author: PluginJoy

sections.description:
SiteBirds for WordPress is built for businesses that want to keep their current website and make it work harder.

Learn more about the platform at sitebirds.com, start from the SiteBirds setup wizard, or view plans on sitebirds.com/products/en.

The plugin gives you a clear starting point inside WordPress:
– scan your site
– review accessibility and site-fix opportunities
– keep useful built-in accessibility improvements active
– open the SiteBirds setup wizard with your WordPress site already filled in
– connect your SiteBirds dashboard with a connect code

This plugin does not inject the SiteBirds widget by default. It is designed as a scan-first and connect-first admin experience.

What you get in WordPress

  • A SiteBirds overview page with a clear scan flow
  • A setup wizard launch page with WordPress-prefilled site data
  • A SiteBirds dashboard launch page for connected sites
  • Local accessibility and site-fix improvements
  • A plugin opportunity scan that shows what SiteBirds may replace or simplify

WordPress data used to prefill the wizard

The setup wizard can use information already available in WordPress, such as:
– website URL
– site name
– admin email
– language and timezone
– active theme
– number of active plugins
– published pages and posts

What stays in WordPress

The local fixes remain available in the plugin:
– image alt text improvements
– heading hierarchy improvements
– link accessibility improvements
– form label improvements
– table semantics improvements
– ARIA landmark improvements
– language attribute improvements
– focus and skip-link improvements
– optional contrast help

Connect flow

  1. Start with the scan in WordPress.
  2. Open the SiteBirds wizard.
  3. Create your SiteBirds setup.
  4. Copy your connect code.
  5. Paste the code back into WordPress.
  6. Open your SiteBirds dashboard.

External service

This plugin can connect to SiteBirds, a hosted service at sitebirds.com.

When you choose to connect, the plugin sends connection and site information to SiteBirds so your dashboard can be created and linked to this WordPress install.

The plugin can also open the public SiteBirds wizard with WordPress-prefilled query parameters.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/a11y-enhancer/ or install it through WordPress.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open SiteBirds in the WordPress admin.
  4. Run the SiteBirds scan.
  5. Keep the built-in accessibility improvements enabled as needed.
  6. Open the setup wizard and connect your SiteBirds dashboard.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin replace my website?

No. SiteBirds is designed to work with your existing website.

Does this plugin automatically add the SiteBirds widget to my frontend?

No. This build is focused on scanning, fixes, setup and connection.

Do I need a SiteBirds account to use the plugin?

No. You can use the scan and local fixes without connecting first.

What happens after I connect?

Your WordPress site can open the linked SiteBirds dashboard directly and continue setup inside sitebirds.com.

Does the plugin guarantee legal compliance?

No. The plugin helps improve common accessibility issues, but no plugin can guarantee legal compliance on its own.
